aggregated_statement_text: If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), Varenia closes the Kestrel Strait; Task Group Kestrel suffers coastal missile losses; combined patrols fail to sustain daily transits, then the Joint Force's ability to protect freedom of navigation through the Kestrel Strait may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to freedom of navigation through the Kestrel Strait in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), Varenia closes the Kestrel Strait; Task Group Kestrel suffers coastal missile losses; combined patrols fail to sustain daily transits, then the Joint Force's ability to protect freedom of navigation through the Kestrel Strait may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to freedom of navigation through the Kestrel Strait in the mid-term (2-7 years).
